purpose: Reusable typed content-slot contracts for OLUK design-system and future Shopper consumers. Slots reference canonical product-content fields and never become a second product-fact registry.

contentStateContract.CONTENT_READY: Approved customer wording or exact fact presentation with field-level provenance. May render on its declared customer surfaces.
contentStateContract.SOURCE_BOUND: The source and meaning are identified, but customer presentation is not approved. Owner-review only.
contentStateContract.PENDING_EVIDENCE_BINDING: The requested value or claim lacks an applicable source binding. Value must be null and the slot must omit or present an explicit unavailable state.
contentStateContract.EDITORIAL_CHOICE: Draft non-factual wording or relationship rationale awaiting editorial approval. Owner-review only.

sourceLayerContract.LABEL: Canonical identity, label facts, composition and label claims.
sourceLayerContract.FINAL_TRANSPARENT_RENDER: Visual product identity, dimensions, transparency, alt text and governed crop inputs.
sourceLayerContract.OPENLAB_JANOSHIK: Record identity, evidence availability, named laboratory source, analytical values and document actions.
sourceLayerContract.WOO_C2: Current price, currency, inventory, purchasability, quantity, cart and order state.
sourceLayerContract.APPROVED_EDITORIAL: Customer thesis, descriptions, route variants, FAQs and relationship rationales after approval; never factual authority.
sourceLayerContract.FIGMA_SITES_COMPOSITION: Placement, responsive behavior and component anatomy only; never product, evidence or commerce fact authority.

globalLaws: Customer routes consume CONTENT_READY static content only.
A slot must not promote SOURCE_BOUND or EDITORIAL_CHOICE content at render time.
PENDING_EVIDENCE_BINDING never carries a non-null factual or claims-bearing value.
Route and module variants reference canonical fields; they do not duplicate or override facts.
Price, inventory, purchasability and schema.org Offer are runtime-only WOO_C2 projections.
Label purity and OpenLab reported purity are separate fields and separate visual labels.
Missing content never falls back to another product, an MK-2866 fixture, generic verified evidence or generic in-stock state.
Governance, provenance and review-state labels are owner-only and stay out of customer UI.

slots.dataOwner: label or owner-locked canonical product projection
slots.desktopBehavior: Render series, name and alias with route-appropriate heading level; status is a separate slot.
slots.mobileBehavior: Preserve display name and alias before optional series; do not truncate into an ambiguous identifier.
slots.fallback: If canonical ID or display name is unavailable, do not render a customer product module. Optional series or alias may be omitted.
forbidden: SKU used as the visible product name

slots.dataOwner: final render registry for the asset; Sites/Figma for chamber composition and crop context
slots.desktopBehavior: Use the governed chamber and context crop for hero, card, featured, relation or dossier presentation.
slots.mobileBehavior: Use the registered mobile crop without changing the product asset or inventing another view.
slots.fallback: Render the governed unpopulated chamber when no CONTENT_READY render exists.

slots.dataOwner: approved product editorial registry
slots.desktopBehavior: One clear customer proposition adjacent to identity, never embedded inside a factual metric rail.
slots.mobileBehavior: Use a separately approved mobile thesis or the full thesis when it fits; never auto-truncate claims-bearing language.
slots.fallback: Omit the thesis and allow identity/facts to carry the surface.

slots.dataOwner: approved product editorial registry
slots.desktopBehavior: Cards consume short, PDP details consume medium, and long-form editorial mounts only in an approved long-copy region.
slots.mobileBehavior: Cards consume the short variant; medium and long variants collapse progressively without changing factual meaning.
slots.fallback: Omit the affected narrative block; do not promote a shorter draft into a long-description slot.
forbidden: source or evidence claim not present in an evidence slot

slots.dataOwner: label or owner-locked projection for strength, servings and label claim; OpenLab for reported purity
slots.desktopBehavior: Three quantified cells retain explicit labels and source semantics.
slots.mobileBehavior: Compact rail preserves all labels; values may fit responsively but may not be reworded into generic chips.
slots.fallback: Use an em dash for a missing value only when the shared rail anatomy is mounted; otherwise omit the metric rail.
forbidden: label purity presented as tested purity

slots.dataOwner: label or owner-locked canonical product projection
slots.desktopBehavior: Definition-list rows with stable labels; facts remain separate from narrative and analytical results.
slots.mobileBehavior: Reorder or collapse rows without changing labels or values.
slots.fallback: Omit the unready row; use explicit unavailable only if the component contract requires a stable comparison row.

slots.dataOwner: label or final approved product information
slots.desktopBehavior: Composition rows sit in their own dossier or disclosure region.
slots.mobileBehavior: Collapse as one composition disclosure; row order follows label order where material.
slots.fallback: Omit the composition section when no rows are CONTENT_READY.
forbidden: ingredient or amount invented from a product class

slots.dataOwner: C2/Woo current commerce projection
slots.desktopBehavior: Use StockPill contract: cobalt in stock, error out of stock, muted unavailable.
slots.mobileBehavior: Same semantic state and wording; no color-only meaning.
slots.fallback: Use Availability pending or suppress the purchase action when the runtime projection is unresolved.
forbidden: content-state promotion used as commerce authority

slots.dataOwner: OpenLab public projection for state and record binding; approved wording for the customer label
slots.desktopBehavior: Place evidence state beside product identity or inside the evidence region; status label matches the exact OpenLab state.
slots.mobileBehavior: Compact status remains readable and precedes collapsed evidence detail.
slots.fallback: Render EVIDENCE UNAVAILABLE only when that unavailable state comes from the evidence contract; otherwise omit the status.
forbidden: inventory styling reused as evidence meaning

slots.dataOwner: OpenLab for record identity and analytical facts; label for comparison claim; editorial registry for explanatory wording
slots.desktopBehavior: Show named record identity before values; keep label and test values separately labelled.
slots.mobileBehavior: Summary first, then progressive disclosure and accessible tables.
slots.fallback: Render explicit partial or unavailable boundary with no analytical values or record CTA.
forbidden: global aggregate presented as a product result

slots.dataOwner: OpenLab source projection
slots.desktopBehavior: Direct action follows named record identity and states whether it opens the Olympus record or original source.
slots.mobileBehavior: Full-width 44px action with the same destination and wording.
slots.fallback: Omit the action and display evidence/document unavailable when approved.

slots.dataOwner: C2/Woo current commerce projection
slots.desktopBehavior: Format the runtime amount once and reuse the same projection in card, PDP, bag and structured data.
slots.mobileBehavior: Use the same runtime amount; compact formatting must preserve currency and value.
slots.fallback: Omit price and suppress purchase action when the commerce projection is unresolved.
forbidden: Sites or Figma as price authority

slots.dataOwner: C2/Woo for action state; canonical registry for identity; Shopper runtime for mutation
slots.desktopBehavior: Action label and enabled state follow runtime inventory and purchasability; design-system candidates remain inert.
slots.mobileBehavior: Minimum 44px target with identical runtime state and no separate mobile commerce truth.
slots.fallback: Disable or omit the action and present Availability pending or Unavailable from the runtime state.
forbidden: cart mutation in the design-system candidate

slots.dataOwner: approved product relationship graph; target product and evidence facts remain with their canonical owners
slots.desktopBehavior: Show rationale separately from target product facts and commerce state.
slots.mobileBehavior: Use a concise approved rationale; never hide the relationship kind or collapse facts into an outcome slogan.
slots.fallback: Omit the relationship card or recommendation entirely.
forbidden: relationship inferred from related or stack arrays

slots.dataOwner: the applicable product, evidence, support or commerce policy owner; editorial registry owns final customer wording
slots.desktopBehavior: Question and answer remain paired and link to the applicable product, policy or record source when useful.
slots.mobileBehavior: Collapsible 44px summary with one complete approved answer.
slots.fallback: Omit the FAQ item and use the general contact/support destination where the route contract allows it.

slots.dataOwner: canonical product registry and approved SEO editorial contract
slots.desktopBehavior: Not a visible layout slot; server metadata uses canonical identity and approved description.
slots.mobileBehavior: Same metadata contract; no device-specific facts or claims.
slots.fallback: Use a non-indexable or generic route policy selected by the SEO owner; do not synthesize product metadata from unapproved frontier copy.

slots.dataOwner: canonical product-content registry
slots.desktopBehavior: Server-generated structured product identity; not rendered as a visible component.
slots.mobileBehavior: Identical server contract.
slots.fallback: Omit Product structured data when required source fields are not CONTENT_READY.

slots.dataOwner: C2/Woo runtime projection joined to verified canonical product identity
slots.desktopBehavior: Server-generated only when current commerce state resolves and matches the visible product surface.
slots.mobileBehavior: Same server projection; no device-specific Offer.
slots.fallback: Omit Offer while retaining eligible base Product structured data.

slots.dataOwner: cart, checkout or order projection for the selected line joined to canonical static identity
slots.desktopBehavior: Name and selected format identify the line; optional small render may appear in bag, checkout summary, confirmation or account.
slots.mobileBehavior: Compact one-line or two-line identity; transaction status and amount retain priority.
slots.fallback: Use exact identity from the transaction owner and omit optional static alias, SKU or media. Never block a transaction on optional product content.

slots.dataOwner: transaction surface owner; product-content registry is intentionally not consumed
slots.desktopBehavior: Suppress product marketing, evidence, recommendation, stack, restock and continuation modules.
slots.mobileBehavior: Same silence rule; transaction status, recovery and support actions remain primary.
slots.fallback: No fallback content. Absence is the contract.
forbidden: any customer product-content slot beyond transaction-owner minimal order identity
